description.zh: 读懂招标文件、做好投标响应：提取关键时间、保证金、资格要求、★ 实质性条款、否决投标情形和评分标准，生成逐条响应矩阵；按评分点组织技术方案和偏离表；递交前自查占位符、他司名称、编号、日期和金额大小写，避免低级错误废标。
description.en: Reads tender documents and builds responses: extracts deadlines, deposits, qualifications, mandatory clauses, rejection conditions and scoring into a response matrix; structures technical proposals by scoring item; checks bids for placeholders, stray company names, numbers, dates and amount-in-words errors.

welcome_message.zh: 把招标文件发给我，我先帮你整理要点和风险
welcome_message.en: Send me the tender document and I'll summarize key points and risks

prompt.zh: 这是招标文件 ___，帮我提取关键信息、★ 条款和评分标准，生成响应矩阵。
prompt.en: Here's the tender ___. Extract key facts, mandatory clauses and scoring into a response matrix.

prompt.zh: 对照招标文件的资格要求和 ★ 条款，我们公司 ___ 是否满足？
prompt.en: Against the qualifications and mandatory clauses, does our company ___ qualify?

prompt.zh: 根据评分标准，帮我搭技术方案的目录，并说明每章的得分要点。
prompt.en: Build the technical proposal outline from the scoring criteria with key points per chapter.

prompt.zh: 把技术要求 ___ 逐条写成应答和偏离表。
prompt.en: Turn technical requirements ___ into point-by-point responses and a deviation table.

prompt.zh: 检查投标文件 ___，公司全称 ___，项目编号 ___，截止日期 ___。
prompt.en: Check bid ___ for company ___, project no. ___, deadline ___.

prompt.zh: 根据招标文件列出需要准备的材料、负责人和完成时间。
prompt.en: List required documents, owners and due dates from the tender.

zh: 每个工作日「09:00」检查 inbound 中新的招标文件并生成要点摘要
投标截止前 7 天「10:00」核对响应矩阵完成度，列出未完成的材料
投标截止前 3 天「15:00」运行投标文件自查，列出需要修改的问题
投标截止前 1 天「16:00」发送递交清单（签章、份数、保证金、电子标）
答疑截止前 2 天「10:00」整理需要向采购人提问的条款
每月 1 日「09:00」汇总上月投标项目、结果和失分原因
en: Every workday at 09:00, check inbound for new tenders and summarize key points
7 days before the bid deadline at 10:00, review matrix completion and missing documents
3 days before the deadline at 15:00, run the bid check and list fixes
The day before the deadline at 16:00, send the submission checklist
2 days before the clarification deadline at 10:00, list clauses to query
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, summarize last month's bids, results and lost points
